result.summary: Found 2 major issues: the rightmost restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' section is visually truncated, and the restaurant name appears cut off. Additionally, there is a partially visible card at the bottom of the page.

issues.description: The third restaurant card (Trattoria Piccol) in the 'Fastest near you' section is horizontally truncated, with the card being cut off on the right edge of the screen. This suggests an overflow or carousel layout issue.
issues.suggestion: Implement proper horizontal scrolling for the restaurant cards carousel, or adjust the card sizing/spacing so all visible cards fit properly within the viewport without being cut off.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' appears to be truncated text rather than a complete name. The full name is likely longer (e.g., 'Trattoria Piccolo').
issues.suggestion: Ensure text truncation uses ellipsis (...) if space is limited, or increase the available space for restaurant names so they display in full without being cut off.

issues.description: A partially visible card (pizza image with -20% discount) is shown at the bottom of the screen, indicating content extends beyond the current viewport.
issues.suggestion: This may be intentional to encourage scrolling, but verify the scroll behavior is smooth and the hidden content is easily discoverable by swiping or scrolling.
